notes: The supplied catalog text is the Fine and Applied Arts Area of Emphasis A.A. Degree (18 units across up to three disciplines, 9 from one discipline), not the Dance A.A. Degree. No Dance A.A. requirements, total or outcomes are printed, so no blocks or outcomes are recorded.
The Program Learning Outcomes in the text belong to the Fine and Applied Arts A.A., not the Dance A.A., and were not recorded.
The Fine and Applied Arts Dance discipline list also names DAN D9, DAN D46, DAN D48, DAN D49 and DAN D51, which are not in the closed list.
Reviewer should check the source URL; it may point to the wrong catalog page for the Dance A.A. Degree.
